dog.description_text:
Fish, the curious kitty is always ready to see what’s happening and maybe have a little fun while she’s at it. Fish is bonded to Pinocle.

Fish is a playful girl who enjoys exploring her surroundings and letting her curiosity lead the way. Give Fish something interesting to investigate or a chance to play, and she’s happy to see where the adventure takes her. Fish is looking for a loving home where she can settle in and really blossom. When she’s not busy exploring, Fish is happy to enjoy life at her own pace. She’d love a pet parent who can give her room to grow, opportunities to play and plenty of reasons to let her curiosity shine.

Ready to see what this little Fish is all about? Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more!

You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours daily, noon to 6 p.m. We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.
